name: Harvard Dataverse API

provider.name: Harvard University, Institute for Quantitative Social Science

summary: Keyless Search and Native APIs for the Harvard Dataverse repository of research datasets, with an OpenAPI spec.
description: Harvard Dataverse is an open repository for research data. The Search API finds dataverses, datasets and files by keyword, facet and date; the Native API returns full dataset metadata, file listings and versions by persistent identifier; the same API is offered by other Dataverse installations.

auth.notes: Public read of published content works without a key; an API token (X-Dataverse-key header) is needed for unpublished content and writes.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented for anonymous read access; the guides list a configurable per-installation rate limiting feature (not re-confirmed for Harvard).

example.response_excerpt: {"status": "OK", "data": {"q": "climate", "total_count": 7235, "start": 0, "spelling_alternatives": {}, "items": [{"name": "Climatic characterization of the sites in Argentina (Córdoba...", "type": "dataset", "url": "https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/DUWBBU", "image_url": "https://dataverse.harvard.edu/api/datasets/4491816/logo", "global_id": "doi:10.7910/DVN/DUWBBU", "description": "Dateset contains past and future exploration on climate in C...", "published_at": "2025-06-16T15:48:26Z", "publisher": "Climate variability in the Americas", "...": "..."}], "count_in_response": 1}}

license.name: Varies per dataset (set by the depositor)

agent_notes: Page with per_page (default 10, max 1000 per the guide) and start until start reaches total_count. Use type=dataset to skip files and dataverses. Read the license field of each dataset (/datasets/:persistentId, latestVersion.license) before reusing data; it is set per dataset.
caveats: Licences differ per dataset; the example dataset reported no license field in its latestVersion.
Total counts differ between runs as the repository grows (7,235 datasets for q=climate today).

verification.notes: Example executed 2026-11-11 (200, access-control-allow-origin: *). OpenAPI spec at /openapi returned 3.1.0 YAML. Dataset lookup by DOI also 200.
